plainText:
Mightyena (Japanese: グラエナ Graena) is a character in Pokémon Chamo-Chamo ☆ Pretty ♪. He is the older brother of .

==History==
Mightyena meets Haruka's Torchic around the beginning of the series and becomes the object of her affection.

In CCP09, Mightyena was seen in the audience for a ness in which Torchic was competing. During the competition, it was shown cheering for her and telling her to do her best. When she lost, he told her that it was only her first time competing in a Pokémon Contest and revealed that he voted for her because he thought she was cute.

In CCP11, it is revealed that Mightyena and Poochyena are not wild Pokémon, but instead the partners of a boy named , who had been away at boarding school. When Kanata returns, Mightyena is frustrated with him for dropping out of his program to spend his time searching for Berries.

==Personality and characteristics==
Mightyena, unlike his brother, is much more tolerant with Torchic.
